feat: align menu key and label spacing (#476)

* feat: align menu key and label spacing

Improve menu display by aligning keys and labels in columns. Keys
are right-padded to match the longest key in each column.

When multiple key bindings are grouped for the same operation (e.g.,
"k/up" or "ctrl+k/ctrl+up"), the maximum width is calculated based
on the combined string length.

Before:
```
 Y Show Refs              b Branch
 k/up Up                  c Commit
 ctrl+k/ctrl+up Up line   h/? Help
```

After:
```
 Y              Show Refs   b   Branch
 k/up           Up          c   Commit
 ctrl+k/ctrl+up Up line     h/? Help
```

fix(log): avoid panic when showing log of a branch with no commits

Opening the log of a branch with no commits panicked with "index out of
bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0". The log screen had no items, so
`line_index` was empty, but `update_cursor` still tried to position the
cursor and indexed `line_index[0]` via `at_line`.

Guard `update_cursor` to reset the cursor when nothing is selectable,
matching the existing empty-checks in the other cursor/scroll helpers.

Closes #262
